question: In which two consecutive years was there no chief guest at the Republic Day celebrations of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021 and 2022.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Republic Day:-**

 
 
• It​ is celebrated in India on **26th January every year** to commemorate the day on which the **Constitution of India** came into effect in **1950.**
 
• The event is marked by a **grand parade** in the national capital,** New Delhi**, which is attended by the** President of India, **who is also the **Commander-in-Chief** of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• However, in some years, there may not be a chief guest, who is usually a** foreign dignitary **invited to attend the celebrations as a guest of honor.
 
• In **2021 and 2022, **there were **no chief guests** at the Republic Day celebrations due to the **COVID-19 pandemic** and the resulting travel restrictions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In **2019**, the chief guest was **Cyril Ramaphosa,** the President of South Africa.
 
• In **2020**, the chief guest was **Jair Bolsonaro,** the President of Brazil. 
 
• In** 2018,** the chief guest was **Nguyen Phu Trong**, the General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam.
